definitions.explanation: A machine used to cut grass on lawns and fields. Available in push, riding, and robotic varieties.

examples.japanese: {芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{芝生|しばふ}→芝生：03196_shibafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刈|か}った→刈る：02043_karu⟧。
examples.english: I mowed the lawn in the garden with a lawn mower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧だ。
examples.english: The new lawn mower is quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧くる。
examples.english: On weekends, you can hear the sound of lawn mowers from the neighborhood.

notes:
USAGE:
Less common in Japanese daily life than in Western countries due to smaller yard sizes, but still used for parks, sports fields, golf courses, and suburban homes. Robot lawn mowers (⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}) have become popular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芝刈|しばか}り{機|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to run the lawn mower)
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き} (electric lawn mower)
- ⟦{手動|しゅどう}→手動：12890_shudou⟧{芝刈|しばか}り{機|き} (manual push mower)
